name: Buddha's Folly Poker
description: Buddha's Folly is a stud poker variant played with match-pot betting. Each player receives five cards face down. The dealer offers one card at a time to the left; players may accept it and discard one face up to the next player, or reject and pass the card on. When a card is rejected by everyone it returns to its originator. Players then declare in or out; those in show hands and the best five-card hand wins the pot; losers who stayed in pay the match pot for the next deal.

rules.objective: Win the pot by having the best five-card poker hand at showdown among players who declared in; players who stayed in but lost must pay an amount equal to the pot into the next deal (match pot).
rules.gameplay: 1. Ante: all players post an ante. 2. Deal: dealer gives five cards face down to each player; players look at their cards. 3. Card-offer round: dealer turns the next card face up and offers it to the player to the left. That player may accept the card (add to hand and discard one face up, offered to next player) or reject and pass the card to the next player. This continues around the table until a card is rejected by every player and returns to the player who discarded or first rejected it. 4. Declaration: all players declare in or out (simultaneously or in sequence as agreed). 5. Showdown: players who stayed in reveal hands; best five-card poker hand wins the pot. Any other player who stayed in must pay an amount equal to the pot for the next deal.
